Name: Dragon's Advancing Sprinklers (Content Patcher)
Author: dragon3025
Description:
This is a modified version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3093]Org's Advancing Sprinklers[/url]. The sprinkler recipes still use the previous tier of sprinkler, but this is added as an optional recipe instead of overwriting the vanilla recipe. This means that you can craft a previous tier sprinkler and upgrade them later for an extra cost or craft the higher tier sprinkler right away. It also includes support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools[/url].

Configuration:
[list]
[*]Replace Vanilla: (Default: False). If True, it will replace the game's default recipes instead of adding new ones.
[*]Primsatic Tool Compatiblity: (Default: True). If True, it will add (or replace if 'Replace Vanilla' is true) recipes for Prismatic Tools.

[/list]
Requirements (lower versions may possibly work, but I tested it with these versions):
SMAPI: 3.9.1+
Content Patcher: 1.20+
